newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador's public foreign debt up to $12.5 bln.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador's public foreign debt up to $12.5 bln.

text.p: Ecuador's public foreign debt rose $98 million in August to $12.5 billion, a Central Bank report said Wednesday.
The public foreign debt in August 1995 was $12.4 billion.
Private foreign debt stood at $1.98 billion in August 1996.
Total foreign debt rose to $14.48 billion in August 1996, up from $13.81 billion in 1995.
Ecuador's government has said it will seek to renegotiate about $2 billion in Paris Club debt, arguing it is stunting the development of the country.
